column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 13 (M24013): Pradaja hampir jatuh, lalu Sangvis Ferri dan
# bala bantuan Griffin datang; Kalina memerintahkan pemotongan jalur logistik musuh.
# Tetap Inggris: Lotta, Balthilde, Limonad, Suomi, Falconer, Porcelain, Lenna, Leva,
# Kalina, Kalin, Sangvis Ferri, Pradaja, Paradajz, Squad 404, Commander, Griffin,
# Frostfall Squad, Cheeta, Helian, Tokarev, Lee-Enfield, FN Squad, New Palette Squad,
# Victoria Squad, MG36, Lise, Griffin & Kryuger Private Security Contractor, Base S09,
# Dreamer, OTs-14, Agent, Groza, Doll, Frame, neural cloud, Elmo.
Waaah—
column2: Huwaaa—

column1: (A sharp whistling sound tears through the defense line of the position.)
column2: (Desingan tajam mencabik garis pertahanan posisi itu.)

column1: (A large-caliber artillery shell lands precisely near Lotta's cover. The violent blast, mixed with shattered concrete blocks, instantly flips Lotta's petite body hard onto the ground.)
column2: (Sebuah peluru artileri berkaliber besar jatuh tepat di dekat tempat berlindung Lotta. Ledakan ganas yang bercampur bongkahan beton pecah seketika membanting tubuh kecil Lotta keras ke tanah.)

column1: (Seeing her companion fall, Balthilde leaps out from behind cover regardless of the danger, raises the light machine gun in her hands, and holds down the trigger tightly at the enemy heavy armored vehicle crushing the ruins as it approaches.)
column2: (Melihat rekannya tumbang, Balthilde melompat keluar dari balik penutup tanpa peduli bahaya, mengangkat senapan mesin ringan di tangannya, dan menahan pelatuknya rapat ke arah kendaraan lapis baja berat musuh yang mendekat sambil menggencet puing.)

column1: (A dense hail of bullets hit the armored vehicle's reactive armor, sparking a series of ineffective flashes.)
column2: (Hujan proyektil yang rapat menghantam armor reaktif kendaraan itu, memercikkan rentetan kilatan yang tidak berguna.)

column1: (This was undoubtedly a suicidal decoy tactic, but she successfully attracted the attention of the vehicle's fire control system.)
column2: (Itu tidak diragukan taktik pengalih perhatian yang sama dengan bunuh diri, tapi dia berhasil menarik perhatian sistem kendali tembakan kendaraan itu.)

column1: (The heavy turret emitted a teeth-grinding mechanical friction sound. The moment the cold muzzle locked onto Balthilde, the shell was already fired.)
column2: (Turet berat itu mengeluarkan bunyi gesekan mekanis yang membuat gigi ngilu. Saat laras dinginnya mengunci Balthilde, pelurunya sudah ditembakkan.)

column1: (BOOM—)
column2: (DUAR—)

column1: Cough... Lot... ta...
column2: Uhuk... Lot... ta...

column1: (Almost at the exact same second Balthilde spoke, the second high-explosive shell, with its corrected trajectory, detonated less than two meters away from her side.)
column2: (Nyaris di detik yang sama saat Balthilde bicara, peluru berdaya ledak tinggi kedua dengan lintasan yang sudah dikoreksi meledak kurang dari dua meter dari sisinya.)

column1: (The terrifying shockwave slammed her heavily against the broken walls and ruins.)
column2: (Gelombang kejut yang mengerikan menghantamnya keras ke dinding pecah dan puing.)

column1: Frame... structural damage rate...
column2: Frame... tingkat kerusakan struktur...

column1: Neural cloud disorder... pres... ￥*...*...
column2: Neural cloud kacau... tek... ￥*...*...

column1: Hydraulic %*#￥...
column2: Hidrolik %*#￥...

column1: (Glaring red garbled code constantly surfaced in Balthilde's neural cloud.)
column2: (Kode acak berwarna merah menyala terus muncul di neural cloud Balthilde.)

column1: (She gritted her teeth, desperately trying to raise her weapon again, but her severely damaged mechanical skeleton could no longer support the weight of the machine gun.)
column2: (Dia menggertakkan gigi, mati-matian mencoba mengangkat senjatanya lagi, tapi kerangka mekanisnya yang rusak berat tidak lagi sanggup menopang bobot senapan mesin itu.)

column1: (Accompanied by a despairing 'snap', her left arm joint completely broke.)
column2: (Disertai bunyi 'krak' yang membuat putus asa, sambungan lengan kirinya benar-benar putus.)

column1: (Balthilde used her visual module, which was constantly flashing with static, to glance at her ruined arm, then desperately searched for Lotta's position through the smoke.)
column2: (Balthilde memakai modul penglihatannya yang terus berkelip derau untuk melirik lengannya yang hancur, lalu mati-matian mencari posisi Lotta di balik asap.)

column1: (Another deafening explosion rang out. But this time, the flash of the explosion did not come from the enemy's muzzle.)
column2: (Satu ledakan memekakkan lagi berbunyi. Tapi kali ini kilatan ledakannya tidak datang dari laras musuh.)

column1: (Balthilde's eyes widen in surprise—the side of the arrogant armored vehicle ahead has been melted into a terrifyingly huge hole!)
column2: (Mata Balthilde membelalak kaget—sisi kendaraan lapis baja yang angkuh di depannya sudah dilelehkan jadi lubang raksasa yang mengerikan!)

column1: (Billowing black smoke accompanied by the flames of a secondary explosion shoots into the sky, and the steel behemoth instantly turns into a burning pile of scrap metal.)
column2: (Asap hitam yang menggulung disertai kobaran ledakan sekunder melesat ke langit, dan raksasa baja itu seketika berubah menjadi tumpukan rongsokan yang membara.)

column1: Limonad squad, continue cover fire! Suomi! Bring them back!
column2: Regu Limonad, lanjutkan tembakan perlindungan! Suomi! Bawa mereka kembali!

column1: Everyone, abandon the trade market and the residential area to the northeast!
column2: Semuanya, tinggalkan pasar perdagangan dan area permukiman di timur laut!

column1: Falconer squad, Porcelain squad, use drone smoke and smoke grenades to cover the retreat.
column2: Regu Falconer, regu Porcelain, pakai asap drone dan granat asap untuk melindungi penarikan diri.

column1: Lenna, detonate the pre-planted building explosives, use the ruins to create roadblocks for the enemy, and buy us some time!
column2: Lenna, ledakkan bahan peledak yang sudah dipasang di bangunan, pakai puingnya untuk membuat penghalang jalan bagi musuh, dan belikan kami waktu!

column1: Understood! I'll bring them back right away!
column2: Dimengerti! Aku akan membawa mereka kembali sekarang!

column1: Alright! I'll blow all the enemies away right now!
column2: Baik! Akan kuledakkan semua musuhnya sekarang!

column1: Kalina, passively consuming our resources like this isn't a solution. Our heavy firepower resources have been exhausted.
column2: Kalina, menghabiskan sumber daya secara pasif seperti ini bukan solusi. Sumber daya daya tembak berat kita sudah habis.

column1: Sangvis Ferri just sent a message. Their arrival time will be later than expected...
column2: Sangvis Ferri baru mengirim pesan. Waktu kedatangan mereka akan lebih lambat dari perkiraan...

column1: I know you don't want to give up. But when necessary, I will still prioritize ensuring your personal safety.
column2: Aku tahu kau tidak ingin menyerah. Tapi kalau perlu, aku tetap akan mendahulukan keselamatan dirimu.

column1: 我知道……
column2: Aku tahu...

column1: No, it's still not enough...
column2: Tidak, masih belum cukup...

column1: ...The enemy artillery's reload interval... is lengthening.
column2: ...Jeda isi ulang artileri musuh... makin panjang.

column1: But the resources we can use have bottomed out... If the enemy commander gets desperate, how are we going to stop them...
column2: Tapi sumber daya yang bisa kita pakai sudah menyentuh dasar... Kalau komandan musuh jadi nekat, bagaimana kita menghentikannya...

column1: Leva! Kalina! This is bad, the enemy has deployed another armored unit!
column2: Leva! Kalina! Gawat, musuh mengerahkan satu unit lapis baja lagi!

column1: And there are more human mercenaries flanking us from the perimeter... Waaaaah!
column2: Dan ada lebih banyak tentara bayaran manusia yang mengapit kita dari tepi... Huwaaaa!

column1: I'm sorry, Leva, I've been spotted!
column2: Maaf, Leva, aku terlihat!

column1: The collapsed building barricades won't hold for much longer, and they have reinforcements on the way!
column2: Barikade bangunan yang diruntuhkan tidak akan bertahan lama, dan bala bantuan mereka sedang datang!

column1: (Lenna's intel quickly drops the atmosphere in the comms to freezing point, and Kalina's heart sinks to the bottom.)
column2: (Intel Lenna cepat menjatuhkan suasana di saluran komunikasi ke titik beku, dan hati Kalina tenggelam ke dasar.)

column1: (She knew the current situation better than anyone. The vast majority of those in Pradaja were inexperienced modified civilian Dolls, and the humans rescued here were mostly severely injured.)
column2: (Dia lebih tahu dari siapa pun bagaimana situasinya sekarang. Sebagian besar yang ada di Pradaja adalah Doll sipil hasil modifikasi yang tidak berpengalaman, dan manusia yang diselamatkan di sini kebanyakan terluka berat.)

column1: (And the situation of our main combat forces, like Squad 404, was not optimistic.)
column2: (Dan kondisi kekuatan tempur utama kami, seperti Squad 404, tidak menggembirakan.)
（Duar——）

column1: (Another close-range artillery strike hit, the explosion landing just a few meters away from Kalina's cover.)
column2: (Satu hantaman artileri jarak dekat lagi mendarat, ledakannya jatuh hanya beberapa meter dari tempat berlindung Kalina.)

column1: (Coughing)
column2: (Terbatuk)

column1: (The smoke and dust kicked up by the artillery fire made Kalina cough violently, but the fighting spirit in her eyes still burned fiercely.)
column2: (Asap dan debu yang terangkat tembakan artileri itu membuat Kalina terbatuk keras, tapi semangat tempur di matanya tetap membara ganas.)

column1: (She didn't flinch at all, but instead stared intently at the enemy and friendly situation map on the tactical terminal while forcefully taking the safety off her self-defense weapon.)
column2: (Dia sama sekali tidak menciut, malah menatap lekat peta situasi musuh dan kawan di terminal taktisnya sembari membuka kunci pengaman senjata pertahanan dirinya dengan paksa.)

column1: (She took a deep breath of the smoke-filled air, as if returning to the moment she stepped onto the battlefield ten years ago.)
column2: (Dia menarik napas panjang dari udara yang penuh asap, seolah kembali ke saat dia melangkah ke medan tempur sepuluh tahun lalu.)

column1: (Back then... when she felt panicked, that person was still looking for a way out.)
column2: (Waktu itu... saat dia merasa panik, orang itu masih mencari jalan keluar.)

column1: Commander... I still can't replace you...
column2: Commander... aku tetap tidak bisa menggantikanmu...

column1: Kalin! We have to go now!
column2: Kalin! Kita harus pergi sekarang!

column1: Lenna! Come back immediately and evacuate Kalin!
column2: Lenna! Segera kembali dan bawa Kalin keluar!

column1: I, I'll find a way to get out right away!
column2: A-aku akan segera mencari jalan keluar!

column1: (Kalina rarely shakes her head, rejecting Leva's proposal.)
column2: (Kalina yang jarang menggeleng kini menolak usul Leva.)

column1: No... I can't retreat... I must...
column2: Tidak... aku tidak bisa mundur... aku harus...

column1: (This is that person's last retreat, even if right now, he is not here, and it's not even known when he will return.)
column2: (Ini tempat mundur terakhir orang itu, meski sekarang dia tidak ada di sini, dan bahkan tidak diketahui kapan dia kembali.)

column1: (But she unconditionally believes in that person, believes that he will definitely be safe and sound, and believes that he will definitely create new miracles.)
column2: (Tapi dia percaya pada orang itu tanpa syarat, percaya dia pasti selamat, dan percaya dia pasti menciptakan keajaiban baru.)

column1: I will, I will definitely—protect the Commander—!
column2: Aku akan, aku pasti akan—melindungi Commander—!

column1: (Boom—)
column2: (Duar—)

column1: (Another earth-shattering explosion.)
column2: (Satu ledakan yang mengguncang bumi lagi.)

column1: (However, this time, the explosion landed behind the enemy's lines.)
column2: (Namun kali ini ledakannya jatuh di belakang barisan musuh.)

column1: Lenna! Report the situation, what happened?
column2: Lenna! Laporkan situasinya, apa yang terjadi?

column1: Leva! Kalina! Someone has cut into the enemy's rear flank!
column2: Leva! Kalina! Ada yang menyelip masuk ke sayap belakang musuh!

column1: Ah... th-that's... Sangvis Ferri! ...And... others...?
column2: Ah... i-itu... Sangvis Ferri! ...Dan... yang lain...?

column1: Th-that flag! It's, it's—
column2: B-bendera itu! Itu, itu—

column1: Griffin's reinforcements!!!
column2: Bala bantuan Griffin!!!

column1: （嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀嘀——）
column2: （Tit tit tit tit tit tit——）

column1: (A comms frequency that had been encrypted with countless layers and had been silent for a long time suddenly let out an extremely piercing call.)
column2: (Sebuah frekuensi komunikasi yang dienkripsi berlapis-lapis dan sudah lama sunyi tiba-tiba melepas panggilan yang sangat menusuk.)

column1: Hello, hello—Captain! The comms are connected! Wait, Cheeta! Don't lead them charging up again—
column2: Halo, halo—Captain! Komunikasinya tersambung! Tunggu, Cheeta! Jangan memimpin mereka menerjang lagi—

column1: ...What? You still want me to handle comms? ...Fine.
column2: ...Apa? Kau masih mau aku yang pegang komunikasi? ...Baiklah.

column1: Sigh, what a hassle...
column2: Haah, menyusahkan sekali...

column1: Anyway, Miss Kalin, I'll communicate with you in place of my Captain.
column2: Pokoknya, Miss Kalin, aku yang akan berkomunikasi denganmu menggantikan Captain-ku.

column1: —Frostfall Squad, reporting in.
column2: —Frostfall Squad, lapor.

column1: Miss Helian and the Captain entrusted me to send you their most sincere greetings. She has been very worried about your and the Commander's safety.
column2: Miss Helian dan Captain menitipkan salam paling tulus mereka untukmu. Dia sangat mengkhawatirkan keselamatanmu dan Commander.

column1: We will take care of eliminating the enemy's heavy firepower positions. Please continue to secure Pradaja's core defense line.
column2: Kami yang akan mengurus pelenyapan posisi daya tembak berat musuh. Tolong lanjutkan menjaga garis pertahanan inti Pradaja.

column1: I see. I was wondering who the Griffin reinforcements Lenna mentioned were, but if it's you, it's not surprising.
column2: Begitu. Aku sempat bertanya-tanya siapa bala bantuan Griffin yang disebut Lenna, tapi kalau kalian, itu tidak mengherankan.

column1: Should we praise the Commander for planning ahead? But even if you are a unit composed of elite Dolls, taking out the enemy's artillery is a bit of a stretch, isn't it?
column2: Apa kita harus memuji Commander karena merencanakan lebih awal? Tapi meski kalian unit yang terdiri dari Doll elite, menghabisi artileri musuh itu agak memaksakan, kan?

column1: Hmph, we never said... we were the only ones who came today.
column2: Hmph, kami tidak pernah bilang... hanya kami yang datang hari ini.

column1: (Another urgent comms request came in. The moment Kalina tremblingly pressed the answer button, a gentle and familiar voice echoed in her ear, crossing the long years.)
column2: (Satu permintaan komunikasi mendesak lagi masuk. Begitu Kalina menekan tombol jawab dengan gemetar, sebuah suara lembut yang dia kenal bergaung di telinganya, melintasi tahun-tahun yang panjang.)

column1: Sorry to keep you waiting, Miss Kalin.
column2: Maaf sudah membuatmu menunggu, Miss Kalin.

column1: Just like ten years ago—we're here.
column2: Sama seperti sepuluh tahun lalu—kami di sini.

column1: Tokarev, reporting for duty.
column2: Tokarev, lapor untuk bertugas.

column1: (Beep beep beep beep beep beep—)
column2: (Tit tit tit tit tit tit—)

column1: (As if some emotion suppressed for ten years has finally found an outlet. The ringtones of the encrypted frequency begin to sound frantically and continuously, like a symphony of dawn playing on the desperate scorched earth.)
column2: (Seolah emosi yang ditahan sepuluh tahun akhirnya menemukan saluran. Nada panggil frekuensi terenkripsi itu mulai berbunyi liar dan tanpa henti, seperti simfoni fajar yang dimainkan di tanah hangus yang putus asa.)

column1: (On the tactical map, a familiar yet long-absent color begins to sweep across the battlefield.)
column2: (Di peta taktisnya, sebuah warna yang dikenal tapi sudah lama tidak ada mulai menyapu medan tempur.)

column1: Lee-Enfield, leading the FN Squad, New Palette Squad, and Victoria Squad into combat.
column2: Lee-Enfield, memimpin FN Squad, New Palette Squad, dan Victoria Squad masuk ke pertempuran.

column1: For everything the Commander wants to protect, we will bring him the glory of victory.
column2: Untuk semua yang ingin dilindungi Commander, kami akan membawakan kemuliaan kemenangan untuknya.

column1: MG36—Lise, commence fire support!
column2: MG36—Lise, mulai dukungan tembakan!

column1: (One, two, ten, dozens... even hundreds! Those identification signals belonging exclusively to the depths of Kalina's memory light up the entire holographic screen like stars.)
column2: (Satu, dua, sepuluh, puluhan... bahkan ratusan! Sinyal identifikasi yang hanya ada di dasar ingatan Kalina itu menyalakan seluruh layar holografis seperti bintang.)

column1: (That is Griffin & Kryuger Private Security Contractor, that is Base S09, the love and hope that has been passed down from the very beginning, hidden and secretly accumulated for ten years.)
column2: (Itu Griffin & Kryuger Private Security Contractor, itu Base S09, kasih dan harapan yang diteruskan sejak awal, disembunyikan dan dikumpulkan diam-diam selama sepuluh tahun.)

column1: (Then, the signal changed slightly, and three somewhat familiar identification codes connected as well.)
column2: (Lalu sinyalnya sedikit berubah, dan tiga kode identifikasi yang agak dikenal ikut tersambung.)

column1: I say, aren't you about done catching up? You only got here by hitching a ride with us, so why are you acting like the main characters?
column2: Begini ya, belum selesai bernostalgianya? Kalian sampai di sini cuma karena menumpang kami, kenapa berlagak jadi tokoh utama?

column1: Hahahahaha, Dreamer! So you were feeling left out—
column2: Hahahahaha, Dreamer! Jadi kau merasa ditinggalkan—

column1: You shut up!
column2: Tutup mulutmu!

column1: ...You shut up too. I'm really starting to regret bringing you guys along.
column2: ...Kau juga tutup mulut. Aku benar-benar mulai menyesal membawa kalian.

column1: Miss Kalina, sorry to keep you waiting. I hope we arrived in time.
column2: Miss Kalina, maaf sudah membuatmu menunggu. Kuharap kami datang tepat waktu.

column1: Miss Kalina, we've returned together as well.
column2: Miss Kalina, kami juga sudah kembali bersama.

column1: It looks like the battle is at a stalemate... Captain, should we go repel the armored forces first?
column2: Kelihatannya pertempurannya mandek... Captain, apa kita halau dulu pasukan lapis bajanya?

column1: Yes, the sooner we repel the enemy, the lower our casualty rate will be.
column2: Ya, makin cepat musuh dihalau, makin rendah tingkat korban kita.

column1: (Looking at those familiar codenames on the screen, Kalina's eyes turned red. But she forced down all her sobs, her gaze instantly becoming as sharp as a blade.)
column2: (Menatap kode nama yang dia kenal di layar itu, mata Kalina memerah. Tapi dia menekan semua tangisnya, dan tatapannya seketika menjadi setajam bilah.)

column1: Everyone... you came at just the right time! OTs-14 and Miss Agent, please suppress the enemy's artillery strikes first!
column2: Semuanya... kalian datang tepat waktu! OTs-14 dan Miss Agent, tolong tekan dulu serangan artileri musuh!

column1: Tokarev and Miss Lee, I need you to immediately take people to execute an infiltration mission!
column2: Tokarev dan Miss Lee, aku butuh kalian segera membawa orang untuk menjalankan misi penyusupan!

column1: I need you to completely cut off the enemy's supply transport line! According to Groza and the others' intel, this unit carried out an overloaded long-distance raid to find the Elmo and quickly rush to Paradajz. Their heavy armored forces and logistics baggage must be severely disconnected!
column2: Aku butuh kalian memotong total jalur transpor pasokan musuh! Menurut intel Groza dan yang lain, unit ini melakukan serangan jarak jauh dengan beban berlebih untuk menemukan Elmo dan cepat menerjang ke Paradajz. Pasukan lapis baja berat dan muatan logistik mereka pasti terputus jauh!

column1: Judging from the reloading frequency of the artillery just now and the trajectory errors, their frontline ammunition is basically depleted. They are completely bluffing right now!
column2: Dilihat dari frekuensi isi ulang artileri tadi dan galat lintasannya, amunisi garis depan mereka praktis sudah habis. Sekarang mereka benar-benar cuma menggertak!

column1: As long as we can cut off their supply line, we can quickly force them to retreat!
column2: Selama jalur pasokan mereka bisa kita potong, kita bisa cepat memaksa mereka mundur!

column1: There's a problem with the enemy's logistics... Miss Kalina, are you sure?
column2: Ada masalah di logistik musuh... Miss Kalina, kau yakin?

column1: (Kalina wiped the dust off her face and revealed a confident smile.)
column2: (Kalina mengusap debu dari wajahnya dan menampakkan senyum penuh percaya diri.)

column1: I am Griffin's logistics officer, you know.
column2: Aku ini petugas logistik Griffin, lho.

column1: (A seemingly irrelevant answer, yet it was a reason that all Griffin Dolls absolutely believed in.)
column2: (Jawaban yang tampak tidak berkaitan, tapi itu alasan yang sepenuhnya dipercaya semua Doll Griffin.)

column1: Yes, you're right.
column2: Ya, kau benar.

column1: We understand... Miss Lee?
column2: Kami paham... Miss Lee?

column1: Leave your back to me, Miss Tokarev.
column2: Serahkan punggungmu padaku, Miss Tokarev.

column1: We will execute the task of cutting off their supplies.
column2: Kami akan menjalankan tugas memotong pasokan mereka.

column1: I swear upon the name of 'Lee-Enfield'.
column2: Aku bersumpah atas nama 'Lee-Enfield'.

column1: Absolutely no supplies will be able to reach the enemy's position.
column2: Sama sekali tidak akan ada pasokan yang bisa mencapai posisi musuh.

column1: Who could still not feel reassured after hearing such a line?
column2: Siapa yang masih tidak tenang setelah mendengar kalimat seperti itu?

column1: ...I'm counting on you, Miss Lee.
column2: ...Aku mengandalkanmu, Miss Lee.

column1: Then, leave the task of launching a frontal assault on the enemy's main force and shattering their formation to me!
column2: Kalau begitu, serahkan tugas menyerang kekuatan utama musuh dari depan dan menghancurkan formasi mereka padaku!

column1: Miss Kalina, please get some good rest. The upcoming battlefield—
column2: Miss Kalina, tolong beristirahat dengan baik. Medan tempur setelah ini—

column1: Please leave it to us—leave it to 'Griffin'!
column2: Serahkan pada kami—serahkan pada 'Griffin'!
